name: pocketagent
description: Provider-agnostic mobile agent platform: Android app + orchestrator + adapter shim plugins (opencode, kilo, claude, pi, junie)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p server && tsc -p shims/opencode && tsc -p shims/kilo && tsc -p shims/claude && tsc -p shims/pi && tsc -p shims/junie
scripts.smoke:shims: npm run smoke -w shims/opencode --if-present && npm run smoke -w shims/kilo --if-present && npm run smoke -w shims/claude --if-present && npm run smoke -w shims/pi --if-present && npm run smoke -w shims/junie --if-present
